description: This file defines the ConduitContext class, a subclass of Entity Framework's DbContext, which manages the database interactions for the application's domain entities such as Articles, Comments, Persons, Tags, ArticleTags, ArticleFavorites, and FollowedPeople. It sets up entity configurations and relationships, as well as transaction management methods.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: Entity Framework database context for the Conduit application, managing entity sets and their relationships, and providing transaction handling.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Configures entity relationships and primary keys for many-to-many join entities.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active, unless using an in-memory database.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, with error handling to rollback if necessary.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back and disposes of the current transaction.
